title: Trial Merge Audit
description: Push-free local evidence for a PR: the verification commands run on the merged tree under base-tip tooling. Evidence only; it does not change F1 routing.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version of the trial-merge audit document.

verdict.description: passed only when every command passed, install succeeded, and toolingChanged is empty; failed when a command failed on the merged content; not-run for setup failures, for a non-empty toolingChanged, for absent commands with an empty toolingChanged (commands-unavailable), and for a command cut off by its timeout (command-timed-out).

prHeadSha.description: PR head commit SHA, or null when it could not be read.

baseSha.description: Base tip commit SHA, or null when it could not be read.

trialCommit.description: Trial commit that holds the merged tree, or null when none was created. It is an object only and no ref points at it.

commands.description: The fixed verification commands in order, with their exit codes.

argv.description: Argument vector the command ran with.

exitCode.description: Exit code, or null when the command did not run.

passed.description: Whether the command exited 0 on the merged content.

toolingChanged.description: Tooling paths where the PR head differs from the base tip.

install.description: Result of the fresh frozen-lockfile install in the scratch worktree, or null when no install ran.

exitCode.description: Install exit code, or null when the install did not run.

worktreeRemoved.description: Whether no scratch worktree remains after the run.

reasons.description: Why the verdict is not passed, such as tooling-changed, content-conflict, install-failed, or command-failed.
